metadata.title: Pertuzumab and Trastuzumab with Chemotherapy
metadata.indication: NCCP00350a: adult high-risk HER2-positive neoadjuvant treatment with separately selected chemotherapy. NCCP00350b: adjuvant high-risk HER2-positive treatment; source records pertuzumab reimbursement not approved. Verify access separately.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Source/software review does not establish clinical authorisation.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: Neoadjuvant treatment of adult patients with HER2-positive locally advanced, inflammatory or early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.

dose.value: refer to linked NCCP chemotherapy regimen

anthracycline_completed.label: Anthracycline component completed before starting HER2 therapy

indication_eligible.label: Full NCCP indication and prior-treatment criteria met

severe_dyspnoea_at_rest.label: Dyspnoea at rest due to malignancy / comorbidity

cardiac_monitoring_overdue.label: Required echo / MUGA result overdue or unavailable

days_since_last_antibody.label: Days since last IV dual-HER2 infusion

companion_regimen_confirmed.label: Companion chemotherapy NCCP regimen selected and separately assessed

her2_hypersensitivity_grade.label: Current HER2-antibody reaction grade
her2_hypersensitivity_grade.source_grading_note: The regimen gives treatment-action thresholds, not a complete grading table. Confirm the exact adverse event and its clinician-assessed grade; do not infer severity from a single symptom or LVEF value.
her2_hypersensitivity_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm the named adverse event and grading criteria with the treating team before applying the source treatment-action threshold.

severe_persistent_diarrhoea.label: Severe or prolonged diarrhoea not improving

rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate supplied values independently. Missing values remain unassessed; never infer normality or phase.

action.recommendation: Hold pertuzumab and trastuzumab at least 3 weeks for LVEF <50% AND decline ≥10 percentage points. Source restart criteria: LVEF ≥50% OR decline <10 points, after repeat assessment and consultant review. No improvement/further decline: consider discontinuation and cardiology.

output_templates.proceed: Antibody safety domains only. The companion chemotherapy requires its own NCCP assessment; this result is not whole-regimen clearance.
output_templates.coverage_gap: One or more potentially relevant protocol domains were not assessed.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: The companion chemotherapy is not fixed in the catalogue title; antiemetic prophylaxis must follow the most emetogenic active component.
